cohort: Women who delivered in South Korea between January 1, 2010, and December 31, 2012
finding: The incidence of PPCM was 1 in 1741 deliveries in South Korea, and women with PPCM were older, more likely to be primiparous, have multiple pregnancies, and experience pregnancy-related complications and in-hospital mortality.
mod_finding: Patients with peripartum cardiomyopathy were more likely to have cesarean sections and experience pregnancy-related complications compared to controls.
